name: Jonsered - Angereds kyrka
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage with a described Jonsered-Freden shortcut/alternate; shared route context with Signaturled Göteborg, Gotaleden and local routes

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: 5. Jonsered - Angereds kyrka
keyFacts: Canonical current name is Jonsered - Angereds kyrka.
Official WST slug is 5-jonsered-angereds-kyrka.
Official distance is 12 km / 12000 m.
Official estimated time is 5 h.
Official difficulty is red / hard.
Stage runs from Jonsered in Partille to Angereds kyrka in Göteborg.
Surface mix includes asphalt road, dirt/gravel road and forest path.
Route passes Jonsereds Fabriker/Jonsered Estate area, Jonsereds Trädgårdar, Bokedalen nature reserve, Torpet Freden, Ramsjöarna and onward toward Lexby mader/Angered.

Official text describes two alternatives after Jonsered Estate: a western route through old-road/ravine landscape about 20 minutes shorter, and an eastern route by Lake Aspen/Humlebadet through old-growth woodland that is more demanding.
Official access notes identify Jonsered station and Angereds kyrka bus stop.
Current WST alert warns that the older suspension bridge between Lilla and Stora Ramsjön has collapsed/closed and only the newer bridge should be used.
